items.description: Electron density (ne) at the separatrix, a key parameter characterizing the plasma boundary conditions and scrape-off layer transport.

candidates.name: flux_surface_averaged_electron_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Electron number density averaged over the entire last closed magnetic flux surface, giving the separatrix value across the confined-plasma and scrape-off-layer interface.

candidates.name: electron_pressure_at_separatrix
candidates.description: Local kinetic pressure carried by the electron population at the magnetic separatrix, marking the boundary between confined plasma and open-field-line scrape-off-layer plasma.

candidates.name: electron_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Number density of electrons at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

candidates.name: ion_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Number density of charged ions at the plasma boundary, with each specialization defining whether the value is local or averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface.

candidates.name: electron_decay_length_over_scrape_off_layer
candidates.description: Characteristic outward distance over which electron number density decreases by one e-folding in the scrape-off layer.

candidates.name: electron_density_at_limiter
candidates.description: Electron number density in the boundary plasma immediately adjacent to a plasma-facing limiter surface, evaluated on the plasma side of the magnetic presheath or sheath entrance.

candidates.name: neon_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Number density of neon ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization stages.

candidates.name: flux_surface_averaged_ion_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Number density of ions at the plasma boundary, averaged over the last closed flux surface to represent the separatrix population rather than a single local value.

candidates.name: density_at_divertor_target
candidates.description: Local number density of a specified plasma species or species group immediately upstream of a divertor-target sheath, with ion charge states summed and neutral populations excluded unless explicitly named.

candidates.name: flux_surface_averaged_neon_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of neon ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix), summed over all ionization stages from Ne+ through fully stripped Ne10+.

candidates.name: density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Particle number density of a selected plasma population evaluated at the plasma boundary, the last closed magnetic flux surface separating confined plasma from the scrape-off layer.

candidates.name: electron_density_at_outboard_midplane
candidates.description: Electron particle number density at the low-field-side intersection of a magnetic flux surface with the equatorial midplane.

candidates.name: hydrogen_density_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Number density of hydrogen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all hydrogen ion charge states.

candidates.description: Local kinetic pressure carried by the electron population at the magnetic separatrix, marking the boundary between confined plasma and open-field-line scrape-off-layer plasma.

candidates.name: total_thermal_ion_pressure
candidates.description: Species- and charge-state-summed isotropic kinetic pressure of the thermal ion population, excluding contributions from fast nonthermal ions.

candidates.name: line_averaged_electron_temperature
candidates.description: Thermal energy of the bulk electron population expressed as an energy-equivalent temperature, averaged along a plasma chord.

candidates.name: electron_field_line_average_temperature_over_scrape_off_layer
candidates.description: Electron temperature averaged along an open magnetic field line between upstream and downstream locations in the scrape-off layer.

items.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of first point.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating a geometric point or reference position by perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_flux_surface
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate assigned to the selected flux surface, defined as the midpoint between its minimum and maximum cylindrical R values.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_line_of_sight
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of a specified geometric point associated with a line of sight, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_diagnostic_aperture
candidates.description: Major-radius (R) coordinate of the geometric center of a diagnostic aperture in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_conductor_cross_section
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of the designated reference point associated with a conductor cross-section, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_spectrometer_channel
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of an interpolated geometry point associated with a spectrometer channel, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: inverse_of_major_radius
candidates.description: Reciprocal major-radius coordinate for a geometric point or specified location, serving as a positive geometric factor in toroidal equilibrium relations.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_plasma_filament
candidates.description: Radial coordinate of a plasma filament is the major-radius coordinate, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, of the oblique reference point anchoring one current-carrying filament element's rectangular cross-section.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_plasma_boundary_gap_reference_point
candidates.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of the reference point defining the gap between the plasma boundary and the wall.

candidates.name: radial_outline_of_flux_surface
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of a point on a poloidal magnetic-flux level-set contour, expressed in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_outline_of_wall
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of every point on a wall boundary outline, measured from the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_coil_conductor_element
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of the geometric center associated with a coil-conductor element, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_geometric_axis
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating the midpoint of the plasma boundary's radial extrema, thereby specifying the horizontal position of its geometric axis.

items.description: Array of values for psi.

candidates.name: parallel_fast_ion_state_pressure
candidates.description: Parallel component of the fast-ion pressure for a specific ion charge state, measuring suprathermal ion stress along the local magnetic field.

candidates.name: parallel_fast_neutral_state_pressure
candidates.description: Parallel component of the kinetic pressure tensor for fast (suprathermal) neutral particles in a specified internal quantum or excitation state, directed along the local magnetic field.

candidates.name: spectral_calibration_factor_of_spectrometer_channel
candidates.description: Wavelength-coordinate factor scaling a spectrometer-channel instrument function to detector count rate.

candidates.name: radial_neutral_internal_state_momentum_diffusion_coefficient
candidates.description: Radial component of the momentum diffusion coefficient for neutral particles in a specified internal quantum or energy state.

candidates.name: voltage_of_wall
candidates.description: Electric potential (bias voltage) applied to each wall element in the GGD representation.

candidates.name: ion_state_energy_diffusivity
candidates.description: Energy diffusion coefficient for a specific ion charge state

candidates.name: thermal_ion_energy
candidates.description: Volume-integrated internal energy of the thermal-ion ensemble over a specified plasma region, excluding electron, fast-ion, and suprathermal contributions.

candidates.name: ion_charge_state_average_charge_number
candidates.description: Density-weighted mean ionic charge number for an ion charge-state bundle, combining resolved charge states into one measure of ionization.

candidates.name: perturbed_plasma_magnetic_vector_potential
candidates.description: Vector-potential perturbation associated with a change in the plasma magnetic field relative to a reference state, retaining radial, poloidal, and toroidal components.

candidates.name: ion_state_vibrational_level
candidates.description: Vibrational quantum level of the ion species state, may represent a bundled range

candidates.name: total_ion_energy_diffusion_coefficient
candidates.description: Diffusion coefficient for total ion energy transport on an unstructured grid

items.description: Argon.

candidates.name: argon_density_at_pedestal_top
candidates.description: Charge-state-summed local number density of argon ions at the H-mode edge pedestal top, excluding neutral argon.

candidates.name: neutral_beam_charge_number
candidates.description: Charge number of the ion species from which a diagnostic neutral beam particle is produced, specifying its pre-neutralization ionization state rather than the neutral particle's net charge.

candidates.name: neutral_state_diamagnetic_momentum_diffusivity
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of the momentum diffusion coefficient for a neutral species in a given internal state.

candidates.name: neutral_diamagnetic_momentum_diffusivity
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of the momentum diffusion coefficient for neutral species in the edge plasma.

candidates.name: xenon_source_rate_due_to_gas_injection
candidates.description: Instantaneous equivalent-electron source rate for xenon atoms supplied by gas injection, assigning 54 equivalent electrons to each xenon atom.

candidates.name: ion_charge_state_diamagnetic_momentum_damping_rate
candidates.description: Neoclassical damping rate of the diamagnetic momentum component for a specified ion charge state.

candidates.name: deuterium_tritium_flux
candidates.description: Total neutron emission rate from deuterium-tritium fusion reactions, including thermal, beam-thermal, and beam-beam contributions.

candidates.name: neutral_diamagnetic_momentum_flux
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of momentum flux for neutral species.

candidates.name: argon_prefill_count
candidates.description: Argon prefill count is the total amount of neutral argon (Ar) introduced before plasma breakdown, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with 18 per atom.

candidates.name: radial_neutral_internal_state_velocity_due_to_diamagnetic_drift
candidates.description: Radial component of the diamagnetic drift velocity of a neutral species in a given quantum state on GGD grid subsets.

candidates.name: ion_state_diamagnetic_momentum_diffusivity
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of the momentum diffusion coefficient for a specified ion charge state.

candidates.name: neutral_state_diamagnetic_momentum_source
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of the momentum source term for a neutral species in a given internal state.

candidates.name: hot_neutral_temperature_at_plasma_boundary
candidates.description: Energy-equivalent translational temperature of hot neutral atoms at the plasma boundary, characterizing their random motion after removal of bulk flow.

items.description: Total perpendicular magnetic field (B⊥) at the plasma position during initiation, computed as the quadrature sum of stray and eddy current field components. Relevant for assessing electrical breakdown conditions.

candidates.name: breakdown_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Breakdown magnetic-field strength associated with local magnetic induction during plasma initiation, without selecting a particular source contribution or field-strength representation.

candidates.name: stray_breakdown_magnetic_field_magnitude
candidates.description: Magnitude of the residual magnetic field at the plasma position during initiation, whose incomplete cancelation can inhibit electron-avalanche breakdown.

candidates.name: stray_breakdown_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Residual magnetic-field strength at the plasma position during initiation, produced by imperfect cancelation of external coil fields and capable of inhibiting electron-avalanche breakdown.

candidates.name: diamagnetic_current_density_due_to_perpendicular_viscosity
candidates.description: Diamagnetic component of the current density generated by perpendicular viscous stress in a magnetized plasma, projected along the local diamagnetic direction.

candidates.name: magnetic_field_magnitude_at_pedestal_top_high_field_side
candidates.description: Euclidean magnitude of the total magnetic induction at the high-field-side pressure-pedestal top, including all local directional components.

candidates.name: radial_current_density_due_to_perpendicular_viscosity
candidates.description: Radial component of the electric-current contribution generated by the divergence of perpendicular viscous stress in a magnetized charged plasma.

candidates.name: field_line_length
candidates.description: Arclength of an individually traced magnetic field line during plasma initiation, resolving the field-line length distribution rather than reporting an average connection length.

candidates.name: radial_current_density
candidates.description: Radial component of the electric current density generated by parallel viscosity in the edge plasma.

candidates.name: current_density_due_to_perpendicular_viscosity
candidates.description: Vector electric current-density contribution generated by the divergence of perpendicular viscous stress in a magnetized charged plasma.

candidates.name: parallel_electric_field_at_separatrix
candidates.description: Parallel electric field at the separatrix is the electric field projected along the local magnetic field on the separatrix. It fixes the field-aligned projection and separatrix locus, while more specific names may add an aggregation over that locus.

items.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of position.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_flux_surface
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate assigned to the selected flux surface, defined as the midpoint between its minimum and maximum cylindrical R values.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating a geometric point or reference position by perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_line_of_sight
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of a specified geometric point associated with a line of sight, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_conductor_cross_section
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of the designated reference point associated with a conductor cross-section, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_diagnostic_aperture
candidates.description: Major-radius (R) coordinate of the geometric center of a diagnostic aperture in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_reflectometer_antenna
candidates.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of a reflectometer antenna center from the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_spectrometer_channel
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of an interpolated geometry point associated with a spectrometer channel, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_optical_element
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of an optical element’s geometric center or local-geometry origin, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: inverse_of_major_radius
candidates.description: Reciprocal major-radius coordinate for a geometric point or specified location, serving as a positive geometric factor in toroidal equilibrium relations.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_coil_conductor_element
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of the geometric center associated with a coil-conductor element, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_measurement_position
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating a measurement position by perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_geometric_axis
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating the midpoint of the plasma boundary's radial extrema, thereby specifying the horizontal position of its geometric axis.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_rogowski_coil
candidates.description: Radial coordinate of a Rogowski coil position, equal to the major-radius coordinate of the coil's designated geometric point in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.description: Toroidal component of the magnetic dipole moment of each ferritic element as a function of time. Represents the toroidal projection of the induced or remnant magnetization in ferromagnetic structural components.

candidates.name: toroidal_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
candidates.description: Toroidal component of the ferritic-element magnetization vector: the signed projection of the effective magnetization assigned to a discrete ferritic element onto the positive toroidal direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame. This is the element-level convention, not a pointwise bulk-material magnetization field.

candidates.name: toroidal_magnetic_field_at_ferritic_element_centroid
candidates.description: Signed projection of the magnetic-field vector onto the toroidal direction at a ferritic element’s geometric centroid.

candidates.name: radial_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
candidates.description: Signed radial component of the effective magnetization vector assigned to a ferritic element in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_magnetic_field_at_ferritic_element_centroid
candidates.description: Radial magnetic-field component at the geometric centroid of a ferritic element, projected onto the outward major-radius direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_current_density_due_to_perpendicular_viscosity
candidates.description: Toroidal component of the current density generated when perpendicular viscous stress acts on the charged-particle fluid in a magnetized plasma.

candidates.name: vertical_magnetic_field_at_ferritic_element_centroid
candidates.description: Signed vertical component of the magnetic-field vector at a ferritic element’s centroid in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_diamagnetic_magnetic_flux_at_inside_flux_surface
candidates.description: Toroidal diamagnetic magnetic flux at an inside flux surface is the diamagnetic contribution to the toroidal magnetic flux through the poloidal cross-section enclosed by a selected closed flux surface.

candidates.name: radial_magnetization_of_iron_core_segment
candidates.description: Magnetization of an iron-core segment expressed as magnetic flux density, projected onto the outward major-radius direction and uniform within the segment.

candidates.name: vertical_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
candidates.description: Signed vertical component of the effective magnetization vector assigned to a ferritic element in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_volumetric_force
candidates.description: Toroidal component of the electromagnetic body-force density vector acting on plasma volumes or conducting wall and structural elements, projected onto increasing toroidal angle φ in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Signed toroidal component of the local total magnetic induction, resolved along increasing toroidal angle in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_magnetic_flux
candidates.description: Toroidal magnetic flux is the signed surface integral of the magnetic field over the poloidal cross-section enclosed by a nested magnetic flux surface.

candidates.name: toroidal_vacuum_magnetic_vector_potential
candidates.description: Toroidal (φ) component of the gage-dependent vacuum magnetic vector potential produced solely by toroidal-field coil currents in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.description: Time array for the detailed temporal evolution of a neoclassical tearing mode (NTM), providing a finer timebase than the parent time_slice structure. Independent time variable for high-resolution NTM dynamics including island width, frequency, and phase.

candidates.name: rotation_frequency_time_derivative_of_neoclassical_tearing_mode
candidates.description: Instantaneous angular acceleration of a neoclassical tearing-mode magnetic island, indicating whether its helical rotation is accelerating or decelerating.

candidates.name: frequency_of_neoclassical_tearing_mode
candidates.description: Signed cyclic rotation rate of an individual neoclassical tearing-mode magnetic island, indicating toroidal advance or regression at its resonant flux surface.

candidates.name: reference_frequency_of_wave_beam
candidates.description: Reference temporal carrier frequency of a probing electromagnetic wave beam, specified before frequency conversion or modulation and used as the phase-measurement baseline.

candidates.name: radial_ion_state_energy_convection_velocity
candidates.description: Effective radial convection velocity (pinch velocity) for ion charge state energy transport on GGD grid subsets.

candidates.name: normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_measurement_position
candidates.description: Dimensionless normalized toroidal-flux label that maps a physical measurement position onto a nested magnetic surface between the magnetic axis and equilibrium boundary.

candidates.name: neoclassical_tearing_mode_phase
candidates.description: Angular phase of a neoclassical tearing-mode magnetic island, specifying its helical orientation on the resonant flux surface at a given time.

candidates.name: orbit_integral
candidates.description: Dimensionless orbit average of a specified function along a marker's final transit or trapping orbit.

candidates.name: normalized_gyrokinetic_time
candidates.description: Dimensionless independent time coordinate that orders nonlinear gyrokinetic evolution and indexes time-resolved turbulent fields, fluxes, and moments.

candidates.name: radial_width_time_derivative_of_neoclassical_tearing_mode
candidates.description: Instantaneous radial expansion or contraction rate of the full magnetic-island width associated with one neoclassical tearing mode.

candidates.name: poloidal_ion_energy_convection_velocity
candidates.description: Poloidal convective velocity for ion energy transport on the GGD grid.

candidates.name: deuterium_tritium_flux
candidates.description: Total neutron emission rate from deuterium-tritium fusion reactions, including thermal, beam-thermal, and beam-beam contributions.

items.description: Peak fall time of the temperature sensor signal in a neutron detector module. Characterizes the temporal decay response of the sensor following a signal peak.

candidates.name: temperature_of_neutron_detector
candidates.description: Absolute thermodynamic temperature of a neutron detector assembly or converter material, describing its thermal state independently of neutron-counting response.

candidates.name: spectral_rate_of_spectrometer_channel
candidates.description: Detected photoelectron rate assigned to each wavelength pixel of a spectrometer channel after electronic gain compensation and relative calibration, but before absolute radiometric calibration.

candidates.name: spectral_efficiency_of_hard_xray_detector
candidates.description: Energy-dependent probability that a photon impacting a hard X-ray detector is registered by its detection system.

candidates.name: spectral_efficiency_of_neutron_detector
candidates.description: Energy-dependent probability that an incident neutron within a specified energy band is recorded as an accepted count by the neutron detector.

candidates.name: intensity_at_spectral_line
candidates.description: Uncalibrated photoelectron detection rate obtained by integrating the measured emission signal across an identified spectral line.

items.description: Neutron detector signal in pulse-counting mode (counts per second), recording individual neutron pulses. Used for fusion neutron rate measurement in lower-flux or time-resolved detection regimes.

candidates.name: neutron_flux_of_neutron_detector
candidates.description: Fusion-neutron number flux incident on the neutron detector’s active surface, giving the rate at which neutrons cross each unit of that surface.

candidates.name: neutron_maximum_energy_of_neutron_detector
candidates.description: High-energy endpoint of the neutron kinetic-energy interval assigned to a neutron detector energy band.

candidates.name: neutron_rate_due_to_beam_beam_fusion
candidates.description: Total neutron count rate from neutron-producing beam-beam fusion reactions, summed over represented fast-ion fuel channels in which both reactants are nonthermal ions from neutral beam injection.

candidates.name: spectral_efficiency_of_neutron_detector
candidates.description: Energy-dependent probability that an incident neutron within a specified energy band is recorded as an accepted count by the neutron detector.

candidates.name: total_rate_due_to_fusion
candidates.description: Rate of neutron production by the plasma, formed by aggregating neutron-generating source contributions over the relevant emitting volume.

items.description: Vertical (Z) component of the velocity vector of an individual shattered pellet fragment. Part of the 3D velocity description of SPI fragments generated after the pellet shattering event.

candidates.name: vertical_velocity_of_pellet
candidates.description: Signed velocity component of an individual shattered pellet fragment along the vertical Z direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_velocity_of_pellet
candidates.description: Major-radius component of a shattered-pellet fragment velocity, resolved along the R direction of the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: toroidal_velocity_of_pellet
candidates.description: Signed toroidal component of a shattered-pellet fragment velocity in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: z_direction_unit_vector_of_pellet_injector
candidates.description: Z component of the unit vector aligned with the unshattered pellet velocity immediately before shattering, resolved in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame.

candidates.name: x_unit_vector_of_pellet_injector
candidates.description: Cartesian x component of the unit vector along the unshattered pellet velocity immediately before shattering, resolved in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame.

candidates.name: y_unit_vector_of_pellet_injector
candidates.description: Cartesian y component of the unit vector aligned with the unshattered pellet velocity direction immediately before shattering.

candidates.name: toroidal_coordinate_at_shattering_position
candidates.description: Toroidal azimuthal coordinate of the point where the pellet center-of-mass trajectory intersects the shattering element.

candidates.name: vertical_coordinate_of_shattering_position
candidates.description: Vertical coordinate of the shattering position is the Z coordinate of the shatter-cone origin relative to the equatorial plane Z = 0 in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, locating the pellet-fragmentation point.

candidates.name: minor_angle_of_pellet_injector
candidates.description: Minor directional half-opening angle of the elliptic fragment-dispersion cone formed by a shattered pellet injector.

candidates.name: volume_of_pellet_fragment
candidates.description: Geometric volume occupied by the material of an individual shattered pellet fragment, distinguishing fragment size from the intact pellet and surrounding propellant.

candidates.name: bulk_neutral_internal_state_velocity
candidates.description: Bulk translational velocity vector of neutral particles in one specified internal quantum or energy state, given by the first moment of their velocity distribution.

candidates.name: neutral_internal_state_velocity
candidates.description: Bulk translational velocity vector of neutral particles in one specified internal quantum or energy state, given by the first moment of their velocity distribution.

candidates.name: toroidal_coordinate_of_pellet_fragment
candidates.description: Azimuthal location of a shattered-pellet fragment’s center of mass around the machine symmetry axis, expressed in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.description: Upper bound of the real-time (RT) network latency for the electron cyclotron (EC) launcher system, defined as the maximum delay between an RT network command and the actuator beginning to respond. Applies globally unless overridden at a deeper level.

candidates.name: frequency_of_electron_cyclotron_beam
candidates.description: Temporal carrier frequency of an electron-cyclotron electromagnetic beam, setting the cyclotron-resonance condition for plasma heating and current drive.

candidates.name: maximum_angle_of_electron_cyclotron_launcher_mirror
candidates.description: Maximum allowed value of the signed rotation angle of an electron-cyclotron launcher mirror within its mechanical travel range.

candidates.name: normalized_beam_power
candidates.description: Fraction of the total launched neutral beam power for each energy component (full, half, one-third).

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_launching_position
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate locating the electron-cyclotron beam launching position relative to the toroidal symmetry axis.

candidates.name: reference_frequency_of_wave_beam
candidates.description: Reference temporal carrier frequency of a probing electromagnetic wave beam, specified before frequency conversion or modulation and used as the phase-measurement baseline.

candidates.name: voltage_amplitude_of_ion_cyclotron_heating_antenna
candidates.description: Peak magnitude of the radio-frequency voltage waveform on a single transmission-line feed of an ion-cyclotron-heating antenna module.

candidates.name: energy_flux_maximum_at_divertor_target
candidates.description: Peak local energy-deposition rate per unit area on one divertor target surface, combining incident plasma-particle and radiative energy-carrying channels.

candidates.name: energy_flux_at_limiter
candidates.description: Plasma energy deposition rate per unit area on the plasma-facing surface of a limiter, without implying a maximum or other surface aggregation.

candidates.name: net_power_due_to_ion_cyclotron_heating
candidates.description: Net ion-cyclotron radio-frequency power launched into the vacuum vessel by a specified heating launcher before absorption by plasma particles.

candidates.name: wave_current_amplitude_of_antenna_strap
candidates.description: Peak magnitude of the radio-frequency current at a specified position along an ion-cyclotron-heating antenna strap.

candidates.name: second_local_tangential_width_of_electron_cyclotron_launcher_mirror
candidates.description: Full lateral extent of a rectangular electron-cyclotron launcher mirror measured along its designated second local tangential (X2) axis.

candidates.name: vertical_coordinate_of_ece_channel
candidates.description: Signed vertical coordinate of an electron-cyclotron-emission channel’s measurement position in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.description: Wall inventory of a neutral species, defined as the cumulative net particle exchange between the plasma and the wall from t=0. Positive values indicate net deposition into the wall; used to track fuel retention and recycling.

candidates.name: neutral_count_accumulated_at_wall
candidates.description: Cumulative net count of neutral particles deposited into the wall through plasma–wall exchange, referenced to zero at the start of accumulation.

candidates.name: incident_neutral_particle_flux_at_wall
candidates.description: Incident neutral particle flux at the wall is the wall-integrated arrival rate of neutral particles of one specified species moving from the plasma side toward plasma-facing material. It excludes neutral particles emitted by the wall.

candidates.name: neutral_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_pumping
candidates.description: Rate at which particles of a specified neutral species are removed from the plasma region by wall pumping, giving global neutral-particle exhaust throughput.

candidates.name: total_neutral_particle_rate_at_wall_due_to_surface_emission
candidates.description: Wall-integrated neutral-particle number rate emitted into the plasma by surface-emission processes, with cold, thermal, and fast energy categories represented separately.

candidates.name: neutral_internal_state_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination
candidates.description: Outgoing neutral internal-state particle number flux density at a plasma-facing wall due to recombination, resolved by neutral product species and internal quantum state.

candidates.name: accumulated_total_prefill_gas_count
candidates.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of all gas species introduced by injection during the plasma prefill phase, summed over species.

candidates.name: prefill_count
candidates.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of neutral atomic and molecular gas introduced during prefill before plasma breakdown, weighted by bound-electron count.

candidates.name: neutral_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination
candidates.description: Outgoing neutral-particle number flux density from recombination at a plasma-facing wall, summed over emitted neutral species and internal states.

candidates.name: incident_neutral_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination
candidates.description: Incident number flux density of neutral recombination products arriving at a plasma-facing wall, summed over neutral species and internal states.

candidates.name: neutral_internal_state_particle_flux_at_wall
candidates.description: Incident number flux density of neutral atoms and molecules arriving at a plasma-facing wall, resolved by a specified internal state.

candidates.name: rate_due_to_pumping
candidates.description: Rate of particle removal from the plasma through a wall by pumping, expressed as particle-number throughput rather than energy transport.

candidates.name: neutral_source_rate
candidates.description: Net local volumetric rate at which neutral particles are created or removed through all included source and loss processes.

candidates.name: neutral_particle_flux_at_wall_due_to_surface_emission
candidates.description: Neutral particle number flux emanating from a plasma-facing wall surface through surface-emission processes and directed from the wall material into the plasma.

items.description: Physical dimensions of each camera pixel in the X1 and X2 directions. Defines the spatial sampling scale of the X-ray camera detector array and is used to map pixel indices to physical coordinates in the detector plane.

candidates.name: extent_of_soft_xray_detector
candidates.description: Full end-to-end physical size of a soft X-ray detector along the applicable horizontal or vertical detector-plane direction.

candidates.name: first_local_tangential_width_of_hard_xray_detector
candidates.description: Full physical extent of a hard X-ray detector aperture measured along its first local tangential axis for rectangular aperture geometry.

candidates.name: height_of_hard_xray_detector
candidates.description: Full physical extent of a hard X-ray detector aperture along the detector's second local tangential direction, for rectangular aperture geometry.

candidates.name: angular_width_of_camera
candidates.description: Beta angular field-of-view extent of a visible camera channel, defined as the range between the minimum and maximum beta viewing angles in the local aperture frame.

candidates.name: etendue_of_soft_xray_detector
candidates.description: Geometric optical throughput of a soft X-ray detector channel, set by the collecting area and accepted solid angle of its optical system.

candidates.name: first_local_tangential_coordinate_of_soft_xray_detector
candidates.description: Signed coordinate of a soft X-ray detector outline vertex along the first local tangential (X1) axis of the detector-local two-dimensional Cartesian frame.

candidates.name: first_local_tangential_width_of_diagnostic_aperture
candidates.description: Full clear-opening extent of a rectangular diagnostic aperture along its object-local first tangential axis, used to define the aperture geometry for étendue calculations.

candidates.name: second_local_tangential_coordinate_of_hard_xray_detector
candidates.description: Signed coordinate of a hard X-ray detector outline vertex along the second local tangential axis of the right-handed detector-local Cartesian basis (first local tangential, second local tangential, local normal).

candidates.name: x_coordinate_of_diagnostic_aperture
candidates.description: Signed x coordinate of the geometric center of a diagnostic aperture, measured from the origin of its right-handed camera Cartesian (x, y, z) frame.

candidates.name: wavelength_of_detector_pixel
candidates.description: Wavelength assigned to incoming photons at an X-ray crystal spectrometer detector pixel, including Bragg dispersion and curvature-induced variation across the detector face.

items.description: Thickness of an annular layer of the cryostat thermal shield, measured perpendicular to the centreline, where thickness(i) spans between consecutive centreline points i and i+1. Describes the annular layer geometry in the 2D cross-sectional representation.

candidates.name: radial_outline_of_cryostat
candidates.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of each point on the outer outline of the cryostat vessel layer in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: vertical_coordinate_of_cryostat
candidates.description: Signed vertical coordinate of each point on the centerline representing the middle of an annular cryostat vessel layer, expressed in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: thickness_of_cryostat
candidates.description: Local through-wall distance across the cryostat structural vessel, measured along the wall normal between its inner and outer material faces.

candidates.name: vertical_coordinate_of_annulus_center
candidates.description: Vertical (Z) coordinate locating the geometric center of an annulus in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: vertical_coordinate_of_passive_loop_element
candidates.description: Signed vertical coordinate of the second endpoint defining a passive-loop element’s thick-line cross-section in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: inner_radius_of_passive_loop
candidates.description: Inner radius of the annular cross-section of a passive conducting loop element is the Euclidean distance from the cross-section center to its inner conducting boundary. It is nonnegative.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_arc_of_circle_center
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of an iron-core segment’s annular cross-section center in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: thickness_of_breeder_blanket_layer
candidates.description: Non-negative geometric separation between the inner and outer material interfaces of a breeder blanket layer along the specified thickness direction.

candidates.name: radial_coordinate_of_poloidal_field_coil
candidates.description: Center major-radius coordinate of an annular poloidal-field coil cross-section, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: vertical_outline_of_antenna_strap
candidates.description: Signed vertical coordinate of each contour point defining an ion-cyclotron antenna strap boundary, distinguishing the strap outline from its geometric-center location.

candidates.name: thickness_of_passive_loop_element
candidates.description: Transverse dimension of the rectangular cross-section used to represent each passive conductor loop element, measured perpendicular to its central segment.

candidates.name: inner_radius_of_iron_core_segment
candidates.description: Non-negative radial distance from the toroidal symmetry axis to the inner boundary of an annular iron-core segment. Together with the outer radius, it fixes the radial extent of the hollow cross section.

candidates.name: outer_radius_of_ferritic_element
candidates.description: Outer radial boundary of the annular cross-section of a ferritic element in the axisymmetric equivalent geometry, defining the external extent of the annulus centered at a reference point in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: radial_outline_of_vacuum_vessel
candidates.description: Major-radius coordinate of each point on the vacuum-vessel cross-sectional outline, measured from the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.description: Data field in core_transport.

candidates.name: total_implicit_ion_particle_source_rate
candidates.description: Signed coefficient multiplying total ion particle density to form the implicit contribution to the total ion particle source term.

candidates.name: ion_charge_state_particle_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless multiplier that limits particle flux transport for one specified ionization charge state relative to its free-streaming bound.

candidates.name: neutral_state_particle_flux
candidates.description: Signed number flux of neutral particles in a specified internal state through an oriented surface, per unit area and per unit time. It is the surface-normal component of state-resolved neutral particle transport.

candidates.name: neutral_particle_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless coefficient that limits neutral-particle transport flux to a prescribed fraction of the collisionless free-streaming bound.

candidates.name: neutral_species_atomic_mass
candidates.description: Mass parameter assigned to a specified neutral particle species, encoding its isotope or constituent composition for inertial and transport calculations.

candidates.name: ion_particle_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless scaling factor that limits aggregate ion particle transport to a physically admissible fraction of its collisionless free-streaming reference flux.

candidates.name: poloidal_ion_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless scalar flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming upper bound on poloidal momentum-flux density for a specific ion charge state in multi-fluid edge plasma transport models.

candidates.name: parallel_plasma_velocity
candidates.description: Parallel component of the bulk plasma center-of-mass velocity along the local magnetic-field direction, representing field-aligned mass transport of all contributing species.

candidates.name: momentum_flux
candidates.description: Rate of transport of linear momentum per unit area across an oriented surface in the plasma, combining convective, isotropic pressure, and viscous stress contributions from any species or population.

candidates.name: momentum_source_rate
candidates.description: Rate characterizing the addition, removal, or transfer of momentum to a plasma population, expressed relative to its associated momentum content.

candidates.name: parallel_ion_charge_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless parallel ion charge-state momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the collisionless free-streaming bound on field-aligned momentum transport for a specified ion charge state.

candidates.name: poloidal_neutral_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Dimensionless poloidal flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming bound on the poloidal momentum-flux-density component for a specified neutral particle state in edge-plasma transport closures.

candidates.name: normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_internal_transport_barrier
candidates.description: Dimensionless magnetic-surface coordinate locating the internal transport barrier between the magnetic axis and the last closed flux surface.

candidates.name: radial_neutral_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
candidates.description: Radial component of the momentum flux limiter coefficient for neutral particles in edge transport models.

items.description: Contribution of the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential (δA∥) to the normalised turbulent particle flux, in the 3D nonlinear gyrokinetic output summed over kx in the rotating frame. Captures the electromagnetic (magnetic flutter) component of particle transport.

candidates.name: perpendicular_momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
candidates.description: Normalized toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, restricted to the perpendicular velocity-space channel.

candidates.name: momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
candidates.description: Dimensionless toroidal plasma-momentum flux contribution driven by the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, generalized across parallel and perpendicular velocity-space channels.

candidates.name: particle_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Normalized turbulent particle flux due to the perturbed parallel magnetic field is the contribution of parallel magnetic-field fluctuations to particle transport across magnetic flux surfaces. In a linear eigenmode decomposition, it is the corresponding rotating-frame weight when that reference frame is used.

candidates.name: parallel_momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Gyro-Bohm-normalized parallel-velocity component of toroidal momentum flux driven by perturbed parallel magnetic-field fluctuations in gyrokinetic turbulence.

candidates.name: parallel_momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
candidates.description: Normalized toroidal momentum flux contribution from the perturbed parallel electromagnetic vector potential in gyrokinetic turbulence, restricted to the parallel velocity-space channel. Toroidal refers to increasing toroidal angle φ in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

candidates.name: perpendicular_momentum_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field
candidates.description: Gyro-Bohm-normalized perpendicular-velocity component of toroidal momentum flux driven by perturbed parallel magnetic-field fluctuations in gyrokinetic turbulence.

candidates.name: particle_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
candidates.description: Dimensionless gyro-Bohm-normalized contribution to turbulent radial particle transport produced by fluctuations of the perturbed parallel vector potential.

candidates.name: energy_flux_normalized_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
candidates.description: Dimensionless electromagnetic contribution of perturbed parallel vector-potential fluctuations to turbulent energy transport across magnetic flux surfaces.

candidates.name: normalized_perturbed_parallel_magnetic_field_magnitude
candidates.description: Normalized perturbed parallel magnetic-field magnitude is the nonnegative amplitude of a magnetic-field perturbation projected along the local equilibrium magnetic-field direction and divided by a reference magnetic-field magnitude. More specific names may add averaging conventions.
